description: AIStoreAuthProfile defines trusted authentication provider endpoint configuration.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description:
AIStoreAuthProfileSpec defines trusted authentication provider endpoint configuration.
Exactly one of UsernamePassword or TokenExchange must be specified.

serviceURL.description: ServiceURL is the trusted authentication provider base URL (scheme + host + optional port, no path).

tls.description: TLS configuration for connections to the authentication provider.

caConfigMapRef.description: CAConfigMapRef references a ConfigMap containing a PEM CA certificate.

key.description: Key within the ConfigMap data containing the PEM certificate.

insecureSkipVerify.description: InsecureSkipVerify disables TLS certificate verification (not recommended for production).

endpoint.description:
Endpoint is the authentication provider token exchange path.
If not specified, defaults to "/token".

usernamePassword.description: UsernamePassword configures static credential login against the authentication provider.

loginConf.description: LoginConf contains OAuth 2.0 password-grant login details for the authentication provider.

clientID.description: ClientID serves as a public identifier for the client to pass to the auth provider

scope.description: Scope passed to the auth provider contains a space-delimited string listing permissions requested

secret.description: Secret references the K8s Secret containing auth provider admin credentials.

name.description: Name is the name of the Secret.

namespace.description: Namespace is the namespace of the Secret.

passKey.description:
PassKey defines the Secret key for the password the client will use for login.
Defaults to SU-PASS to match AuthN default admin secret format.

userKey.description:
UserKey defines the Secret key for the username the client will use for login.
Defaults to SU-NAME to match AuthN default admin secret format.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of usernamePassword or tokenExchange must be specified
